event.name: SC_SURRENDER_TERRAN
event.text: "Stand down. We can transfer supplies if you let us limp out of here."
"You recieve a jumbled message from the heavily damaged ship. The remaining crew has surrendered and is requesting immediate aid."
"Fine, fine. Take the cargo. Just do not vent us into space."

event.name: SC_DESTROYED_TERRAN
event.text: The Terran ship breaks apart. You salvage what remains.

event.name: SC_ESCAPE_TERRAN
event.text: The Terran ship is attempting to escape.

event.name: SC_GOTAWAY_TERRAN
event.text: The Terran ship got away.

event.name: SC_DEAD_CREW_TERRAN
event.text: With the crew neutralized, you search the Terran ship and secure its supplies.

event.name: FINISH_BEACON_TERRAN
event.text: Do nothing.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_ENGINEERING_UPGRADES
event.text: A Terran Engineering Bay operates at this beacon. Repair drones and maintenance craft move between the station and nearby vessels while its quartermaster broadcasts an offer to upgrade infantry weapons and armor.
Your infantry weapons have already been upgraded to their maximum level.
The Engineering Bay installs advanced weapon modifications for your infantry, further improving their combat effectiveness.
The Engineering Bay equips your infantry with improved weapons, increasing their combat effectiveness.
Your infantry armor has already been upgraded to its maximum level.
The Engineering Bay installs reinforced armor plating and advanced protective systems, further reducing damage taken by your infantry.
The Engineering Bay equips your infantry with improved protective equipment, increasing their resistance to incoming damage.
You power your weapons and move against the Engineering Bay. Warning lights flare across the station as its defensive systems come online.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SUPPLY_DEPOT
event.text: Welcome to the autmoated Terran Supply Depot. Please Deposit surpluss supplies.
Trading Fuel for Scrap.
Trading Drones for Scrap.
Trading Missiles for Scrap.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SUPPLY_DEPOT_RESTOCK
event.text: Please select supplies that are in need of restocking.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_COMMAND_CENTER
event.text: A Terran Command Center operates at this beacon, coordinating military operations and logistics throughout the surrounding sector.

choice.text: Request minor repairs. (5 scrap for 5 hull)

event.text: The Command Center dispatches a repair team to your ship. The damaged sections of your hull are quickly patched.

choice.text: Request major repairs. (10 scrap for 10 hull)

event.text: A full team of SCVs is dispatched to your ship. Their skilled work restores a significant portion of your hull.

choice.text: Purchase an SCV repair drone. (50 scrap)

event.text: The Command Center transfers an SCV repair drone from its maintenance reserves to your ship.

choice.text: Purchase a Comsat sector scan. (15 scrap)

event.text: The Command Center's Comsat network has been hard at work. They transmit detailed sensor data to your ship, revealing the surrounding sector.
You power your weapons and move against the Command Center. Defensive systems activate as the facility prepares to repel your attack.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_BARRACKS
event.text: A Terran Barracks operates at this beacon. The facility maintains extensive ammunition reserves and regularly contracts trained mercenaries to passing vessels.
The Barracks transfers a small shipment of missiles to your ship.
A supply team loads a shipment of missiles aboard your ship.
The Barracks authorizes a bulk ammunition transfer and delivers the missiles to your cargo hold.
The recruitment officer presents an available mercenary. After negotiating a contract, the mercenary joins your crew.
You power your weapons and move against the Barracks. Its garrison scrambles to their launch pods as automated defenses come online.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_RAIDER_EXTORTION
event.text:
You receive a transmission from a settlement on a moon nearby. They complain that raiders harass them constantly, extorting them and taking their resources. Before they can explain any further, your transmission is interrupted by a nearby ship.
"There's nothing to see here, captain, just some ungrateful citizens that don't understand how much it costs to keep them safe. I, on the other hand, am not so naive." A notice for a credit transfer request appears on your screen. They are trying to send you money.
You accept the raiders' payment.
You send them a request for twice as much, right as you begin powering your weapons. If they are as savvy as they claim to be, they will get the message.

choice.text: This is none of your business.

event.text: You order your ship to jump away.
This is obviously unacceptable. You begin powering up your weapons.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_RAIDER_EXTORTION_REWARDS
event.text: With the raiders out of the way, the civilians offer what they can.

choice.text: Accept 10 repairs. (Enemy fleet advances one jump)

event.text: The civilians begin repairing your ship.
The civilians transfer what supplies they can spare.
You thank them for their generous offers, but then remind them that it's not cheap to ward off raiders, and they wouldn't want to come across as ungrateful.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_BROADCAST_STATION
event.text: You pick up a broadband transmission from an abandoned planet nearby and use it to locate a very large structure on the planet's surface. This powerful station is capable of broadcasting signals across the entire system, and they are willing to do so, for the right price.

choice.text: Pay 20 scrap to flood the sector with misinformation about your ship and its location.

event.text: The station broadcasts false information about your ship and its location throughout the sector.

choice.text: Pay 25 scrap to spread propaganda about your crew and your cause throughout the sector.

event.text: The station broadcasts propaganda about your crew and your cause throughout the sector.
You power your weapons and destroy the broadcasting station. You salvage what little remains of the structure.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_BROADCAST_DISCOUNT
event.text:
You ask them if they really want to put a price on 'doing the right thing' at the same moment as your ship begins powering its weapons.
They agree to give you a discount.

choice.text: Pay 10 scrap to flood the sector with misinformation about your ship and its location.

event.text: The station broadcasts false information about your ship and its location throughout the sector.

choice.text: Pay 15 scrap to spread propaganda about your crew and your cause throughout the sector.

event.text: The station broadcasts propaganda about your crew and your cause throughout the sector.
You leave the station without further incident.
As you prepare to leave, a Confederate ship approaches your position. The broadcasting station has reported your threats to the authorities, and the Confederate ship moves to intercept you.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FUGITIVE
event.text:
The satellite at this beacon is part of the sector's active network, so when you arrive, there is already a message waiting for you.
"Listen Captain, just because we don't always see eye to eye doesn't mean we can't help each other out from time to time."
"There's a fugitive hiding at your beacon. He's powered down his systems so he can't be spotted and he's steadily drifting out of our Comsat range."
"Stop him from leaving the sector, and I may forget that you were there at all. Well... all except for the sizable bounty you will receive, of course."

choice.text: Request a Comsat from the Confederate satellite.

event.text: You request assistance from the Confederate Comsat network. The satellite locates the fugitive and transmits his position.
You destroy the satellite and quickly jump away.

choice.text: Dismantle the satellite for a chance at valuable scrap.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FUGITIVE_DISMANTLE_SUCCESS
event.text: You begin dismantling the satellite, carefully removing its valuable components before the Confederate network can detect what is happening.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FUGITIVE_DISMANTLE_FAILURE
event.text: As you begin dismantling the satellite, an emergency transmission alerts nearby Confederate forces. A group of stealthed Wraiths approaches and attacks.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FUGITIVE_HACK_SUCCESS
event.text: You successfully hack the satellite and gain access to the Confederate communications network.

choice.text: Transmit false information to delay the enemy fleet by 2 jumps.

event.text: You transmit false information about your location throughout the network, sending the pursuing fleet in the wrong direction.

choice.text: Use the satellite to scan the sector.

event.text: You access the satellite's surveillance data, revealing the surrounding sector.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FUGITIVE_HACK_FAILURE
event.text: Your attempt to hack the satellite triggers a security alert. A group of stealthed Wraiths approaches and attacks.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FUGITIVE_SCAN_CHECK
event.text: You scan the surrounding area, searching for the fugitive's ship.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FUGITIVE_SCAN_FAILURE
event.text: Your scan fails to locate the fugitive. By the time your sensors finish searching, the ship has drifted beyond detection range.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FUGITIVE_FOUND
event.text: You locate the fugitive's ship drifting nearby with its systems powered down.
You power your weapons and move to stop the fugitive.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FUGITIVE_ESCAPES
event.text: The fugitive flees.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FUGITIVE_INTERCEPTED
event.text: The fugitive flees, but is intercepted and destroyed by a fleet of Wraiths. The Wraiths then turn their attention toward you.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FUGITIVE_WRAITH_ATTACK
event.text: The stealthed Wraiths move into attack position and power their weapons.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FUGITIVE_DEFEATED
event.text: The fugitive has been stopped. You collect what supplies you can from the ship.

choice.text: Use the satellite network to contact the Officer about your reward.

event.text: You leave the area without contacting the Officer.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FUGITIVE_BOUNTY_PAID
event.text: The Officer begrudgingly gives you your reward.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FUGITIVE_BOUNTY_DENIED
event.text: The Officer mocks you and explains that the only big bounty you were getting was the one on your own head.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_DYING_SATELLITE
event.text: Your sensors find a faint energy pulse that leads you to a dying relay satellite.
You dismantle the satellite and collect what useful materials remain.
You rig the satellite with explosives, setting them to detonate when another ship approaches.
You spend some scrap repairing the satellite. Once restored, you access the relay network and download detailed information about the sector.
You use your Backup Battery to jumpstart the satellite. Its systems come back online, allowing you to access the relay network and download detailed information about the sector.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_DYING_SATELLITE_TRAP_CONFEDERATE
event.text: [style[color:FFD700]]* NOTIFICATION *[[/style]] A passive monitoring program you left behind informs you that the trap you set has been triggered. A Confederate scout was destroyed and the pursuing fleet has been delayed.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_DYING_SATELLITE_TRAP_CIVILIAN
event.text: [style[color:FFD700]]* NOTIFICATION *[[/style]] A passive monitoring program you left behind informs you that the trap you set has been triggered. Unfortunately, a civilian supply transport was destroyed. The pursuing fleet has been delayed as they investigate the incident.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_DYING_SATELLITE_SCV_REPAIR
event.text: Your SCV repairs the satellite. Once restored, you access the relay network and download detailed information about the sector.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_MOON_PORT
event.text: The only thing that shows up near this beacon is a dingy little port on the dark side of a small, barren moon.
You pay the port's operator to refuel your ship.
You pay the port's maintenance crew to repair your ship.
You purchase drone parts from the port's supplies.
You purchase missiles from the port's supplies.
You hire a mercenary looking for work at the port.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCAVENGERS
event.text: You arrive at the beacon to find scavengers already picking apart the wreckage of a destroyed Terran vessel.

choice.text: Salvage some scrap without drawing attention to yourself.
(Cloaking) Salvage some scrap without drawing attention to yourself.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCAVENGERS_CONFRONT
event.text: The scavengers notice your approach and warn you to stay away from their salvage.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCAVENGERS_SPLIT_SUCCESS
event.text: The scavengers agree to split the haul. You collect your share of the salvage before leaving them to finish their work.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCAVENGERS_SPLIT_FAILURE
event.text: "Get outa here!" The scavengers refuse to share their salvage and order you to leave.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCAVENGERS_CHASE_SUCCESS
event.text: The scavengers decide the wreckage isn't worth fighting over and quickly retreat. You are free to salvage what remains.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCAVENGERS_CHASE_FAILURE
event.text: The scavengers refuse to abandon their claim. They begin powering up their weapons.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCAVENGERS_STEALTH_SCRAP
event.text: You manage to salvage some debris before quickly jumping away.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCAVENGERS_STEALTH_REWARD
event.text: You are able to strip a stray portion of the wreckage before jumping away.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCAVENGERS_STEALTH_FAILURE
event.text: Despite your efforts to keep a wide berth, the enemy ship must have noticed. They begin powering up their weapons as they move in to defend their claim.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCAVENGERS_ATTACK
event.text: You power your weapons and move to attack the scavengers.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCAVENGERS_COMBAT_REWARD
event.text: With the scavengers defeated, you collect what remains of their ship.

choice.text: Continue salvaging the wreckage. (Enemy fleet advances 1 jump)

event.text: You spend additional time searching the wreckage and collect more supplies before the pursuing fleet can arrive.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CONFEDERATE_DISTRESS
event.text: Your sensors find a distress signal, and to your surprise, it's transmitting from a Confederate ship on an unencrypted channel. Amidst sounds of chaos and explosions, they explain that they are under attack and in desperate need of aid. The transmission cuts out before they can explain any further.

choice.text: The Confederates can take care of their own. Order your ship to jump away.
Seize the opportunity and join the assault against the Confederate ship.
Order your ship to move in and defend the Confederate ship.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CONFEDERATE_DISTRESS_ATTACK_SUCCESS
event.text: You join a squad of ships that are already attacking the surrounded Confederate ship.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CONFEDERATE_DISTRESS_ATTACK_BETRAYAL
event.text: You join a squad of ships that are already attacking the surrounded Confederate ship, only to realize the squad is firing at you instead of them!

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CONFEDERATE_DISTRESS_DEFEND_SUCCESS
event.text: Your ship maneuvers into position beside the Confederate ship as you prepare to fend off the assault.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CONFEDERATE_DISTRESS_DEFEND_ASSAULT
event.text: Your ship maneuvers into position beside the Confederate ship as you prepare to fend off the assault. If you had known how big the assault would be, you may have chosen your actions differently.

destroyed.text: The Confederate ship breaks apart under your attack. You salvage what remains.

deadCrew.text: With the Confederate crew neutralized, you collect their remaining supplies.

surrender.text: The attacking squad has taken serious damage and offers to surrender.

event.text: The squad transfers supplies before retreating from the area.
You reject their offer and continue the attack.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CONFEDERATE_DISTRESS_BETRAYAL_DEFEATED
event.text: With the attacking squad defeated, you salvage what remains. The Confederate ship, still under attack, turns its weapons toward you.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CONFEDERATE_DISTRESS_BETRAYAL_FOLLOWUP
event.text: The Confederate ship moves to intercept you.
You power your weapons and engage the Confederate ship.

destroyed.text: The Confederate ship is destroyed. You salvage what remains.

deadCrew.text: With the Confederate crew neutralized, you collect what supplies remain.

destroyed.text: The attacking ship is destroyed. You salvage what remains.

deadCrew.text: With the attackers neutralized, you collect their remaining supplies.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CONFEDERATE_DISTRESS_ASSAULT_SECOND_WAVE
event.text: The first attacking ship is defeated, and you collect what remains. Another ship from the assault group moves in to continue the attack.
The second attacker advances and opens fire.

destroyed.text: The second attacker is destroyed. You salvage what remains.

deadCrew.text: With the second attacking crew neutralized, you collect their remaining supplies.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_TRANSPORT
event.text: You arrive near a heavily armored Terran transport vessel. Its engines are already cycling up, but it has not jumped yet.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_TRANSPORT_FIGHT
event.text: The transport diverts power to its engines and attempts to flee as soon as you close in.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_TRANSPORT_GOTAWAY
event.text: The transport jumps away before you can stop it. Its FTL trail is unstable, but a strong sensor sweep might still recover its destination.

choice.text: Try to follow the transport's FTL trail.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_TRANSPORT_SURRENDER_TRACK
event.text: The transport powers down its weapons and transfers a cargo manifest fragment along with the surrender payment. The data may reveal where the rest of its convoy was headed.

choice.text: Use your sensors to analyze the transport's route data.
Take the scrap and move on.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_TRANSPORT_SENSORS_CHECK
event.text: Your crew scans the transport's residual jump data, looking for a usable destination.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_TRANSPORT_QUEST_SUCCESS
event.text: Your sensors isolate a clean jump vector from the transport's route data. You mark the destination on your map.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_TRANSPORT_QUEST_FAILURE
event.text: The transport's trail breaks apart before your sensors can resolve a destination. Whatever it was carrying is gone.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_TRANSPORT_QUEST
event.text: You arrive at the coordinates recovered from the transport's route data. The trail leads to a Terran logistics waypoint, but this event is still a stub and can be expanded into a follow-up fight, cache, or special reward later.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL
event.text: Your ship arrives near the edge of a Terran patrol route. Sensor shadows flicker between nearby debris fields.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_DETECT_SUCCESS_1
event.text: Your sensors catch a faint Terran patrol signature before they fully lock onto you. You have a narrow chance to act first.

choice.text: Avoid the patrol and move on.

event.text: You alter course and slip away before the patrol can confirm your position.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_DETECT_SUCCESS_2
event.text: Your improved sensors identify the patrol route before they spot you. You can choose the terms of engagement.

choice.text: Avoid the patrol and move on.

event.text: You skirt the edge of their patrol route and continue undetected.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_DETECT_SUCCESS_3
event.text: Your advanced sensors resolve the patrol's course, weapon profile, and blind spots before they notice you.

choice.text: Ambush the patrol from their blind spot.
Avoid the patrol and move on.

event.text: You pass cleanly through a gap in their sweep pattern.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_AMBUSH
event.text: Your sensors resolve the patrol's course before they notice you. You maneuver into position and spring the attack.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_DETECT_FAIL
event.text: The nearby patrol has detected you and turns toward your position, weapons charging as it moves to intercept.

choice.text: Push the engines and attempt to outrun the patrol.
Push the engines and attempt to outrun the patrol.
(Cloaking) Attempt to avoid the patrol under cloak.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_EVADE_SUCCESS
event.text: You divert power to evasive maneuvers and break away before the patrol can establish a firing solution.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_EVADE_FAILURE
event.text: You push the engines hard, but the patrol anticipates your course and cuts off your escape.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_CLOAK_SUCCESS
event.text: You cloak and drift beyond the patrol's search pattern. By the time your signature returns, the Terran ship is scanning the wrong part of the beacon.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_CLOAK_FAILURE
event.text: You cloak, but the patrol has already narrowed your position. They spread their search pattern and catch you as your cloak begins to fade.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_FIGHT
event.text: The patrol closes in before you can escape. You power your weapons and prepare for battle.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT
event.text: A Terran scout drops out of FTL almost on top of you. It catches your transponder signature before you can mask it and immediately turns to flee.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_STANDARD
event.text: You will have to act quickly if you want to stop the scout from escaping. If it gets away, it will warn the pursuing fleet.

choice.text: (FTL Jammer) Jam the scout's drive before it can escape.
(External FTL Jammer) Jam the scout's drive before it can escape.
Use Hacking to lock down the scout's engines.
Use Hacking to interfere with the scout's engines.
Try to hack the scout's engines.
Engage the scout before it can escape.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_PREIGNITER
event.text: You will have to act quickly if you want to stop the scout from escaping. If it gets away, it will warn the pursuing fleet.

choice.text: (FTL Jammer) Jam the scout's drive before it can escape.
(External FTL Jammer) Jam the scout's drive before it can escape.
Fire a precise volley at the scout's engines.
Fire a targeted volley at the scout's engines.
Try to hit the scout's engines before it can pull away.
Engage the scout before it can escape.
Use Hacking to lock down the scout's engines.
Use Hacking to interfere with the scout's engines.
Try to hack the scout's engines.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_WEAPON_SUCCESS
event.text: Your opening volley catches the scout before it can widen the gap. The shots rake across its engine housing.

triggeredEventBox.tooltip: The scout's damaged engines will recover in this amount of time.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_WEAPON_FAILURE
event.text: You fire as the scout veers away, but the shot goes wide.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_HACKING_SUCCESS
event.text: Your hacking system breaks into the scout's drive control. Its engines lock into a diagnostic loop, buying you time to finish the fight.

triggeredEventBox.tooltip: The scout's engine lockdown will expire in this amount of time.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_HACKING_FAILURE
event.text: You try to break into the scout's engine controls, but its emergency protocols reject the intrusion.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_FTL_JAMMER
event.text: Your FTL Jammer floods the scout's drive with interference. Its escape vector collapses before the ship can jump.

triggeredEventBox.tooltip: The scout's jammed engines will recover in this amount of time.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_GOTAWAY
event.text: The scout jumps away before you can stop it. Moments later, encrypted fleet traffic spikes across the sector.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_FIGHT
event.text: The scout is already turning away, its FTL drive flaring hot. You power weapons and move to stop it.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_ENGINE_STATUS_CLEAR
event.text: The scout's engine systems recover from the disruption.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_DEAD_CREW
event.text: With the scout's crew neutralized, you search its databanks and secure its emergency supplies before any message can be sent. The ship's still-active comms buffer may contain a way to delay the pursuing fleet, but tampering with it could also expose your position.

choice.text: (Sensors) Analyze the scout's transmission logs and try to redirect the fleet.
(Sensors) Analyze the scout's transmission logs and try to redirect the fleet.
(Sensors) Analyze the scout's transmission logs and try to redirect the fleet.
(Sensors) Analyze the scout's transmission logs and try to redirect the fleet.
(Hacking) Attempt to break into the scout's comms buffer and falsify its final report.
(Hacking) Attempt to break into the scout's comms buffer and falsify its final report.
(Hacking) Attempt to break into the scout's comms buffer and falsify its final report.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_CREW_KILL_DELAY_SUCCESS
event.text: You alter the scout's final telemetry before it can be recovered. The pursuing fleet diverts toward a false trail, buying you time.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_CREW_KILL_DELAY_FAILURE
event.text: The scout's comms buffer resists your attempt. The failed intrusion causes an emergency beacon to fire, giving the pursuing fleet a cleaner trail to follow.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_SCOUT_CREW_KILL_REWARD
event.text: You leave the scout's comms buffer alone and focus on stripping the ship before more Terran forces arrive.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_ASSAULT
event.text: A Terran assault group is already waiting at this beacon. Their lead ship moves to intercept, weapons hot and formation tight. This is not a scout or patrol trying to identify you; this is a direct attack.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_ASSAULT_FIGHT_1
event.text: The first Terran attacker breaks formation and opens fire. More contacts remain at the edge of sensor range.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_ASSAULT_SECOND_WAVE
event.text: As the first attacker falls back or breaks apart, a second Terran ship moves in to continue the assault. This one is committed to finishing the fight.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_ASSAULT_FIGHT_2
event.text: The second Terran assault ship advances and opens fire.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH
event.text: You arrive in a quiet stretch of space. The beacon appears empty at first glance: no distress calls, no obvious wreckage, and no active Terran signatures on your sensors.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_WARNED
event.text: One of your crew stiffens before the sensors catch anything. A hostile presence is waiting nearby, masked behind the quiet beacon traffic. You have a brief chance to act before the trap fully closes.

choice.text: Push the engines and try to escape the ambush.
Engage the exposed Terran ship before it can spring the trap.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_SPRUNG
event.text: The empty beacon suddenly comes alive. A Terran ship cuts power to its masking field and moves into attack position. You have only seconds to react.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_ENGINE_CHECK
event.text: Continue...

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_ESCAPE_SUCCESS
event.text: You slam power into the engines and break away before the Terran ship can fully close the trap.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_ESCAPE_FAILURE
event.text: You try to accelerate out of the kill zone, but the Terran ship anticipates your course and cuts off your escape.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_PILOT_CHECK
event.text: Continue...

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_PILOT_SUCCESS
event.text: Your pilot reacts instantly, rolling the ship clear of the main firing lane. The ambusher loses its perfect angle, forcing it into a more conventional engagement.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_PILOT_FAILURE
event.text: Your pilot tries to break away, but the Terran ship already has the vector covered. The ambush lands exactly as planned.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_AMBUSH_NON_AMBUSH_FIGHT
event.text: Warned by your crew, you turn the trap against the Terran ship and force it into open combat.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CLASH_CONFED_SOK
event.text: A Confederate patrol and a Sons of Korhal strike group are exchanging fire at this beacon. Both formations have taken damage, but neither is willing to break off. As you approach, both sides hail you, demanding assistance.

choice.text: Side with the Confederacy against the Sons of Korhal.
Side with the Sons of Korhal against the Confederacy.
(Engines) Attempt to flee while the two groups are distracted.
(Engines) Attempt to flee while the two groups are distracted.
(Engines) Attempt to flee while the two groups are distracted.
(Engines) Attempt to flee while the two groups are distracted.
(Cloaking) Attempt to escape the battle under cloak.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CLASH_CONFED_SOK_SIDE_CONFED
event.text: You move alongside the Confederate formation and engage the Sons of Korhal. The Confederate ships provide supporting fire.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CLASH_CONFED_SOK_SIDE_SOK
event.text: You move alongside the Sons of Korhal and engage the Confederate ships. The Sons of Korhal provide supporting fire.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CLASH_CONFED_SOK_FLEE_FAILURE
event.text: You attempt to flee, but a Confederate ship breaks away from the fighting and moves to intercept you.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CLASH_CONFED_RAIDERS
event.text: A Confederate patrol has intercepted a Raider group near this beacon. The Raiders are fighting to escape, and the Confederates are trying to cut them off. Both sides notice your arrival and demand your assistance.

choice.text: Side with the Confederacy against the Raiders.
Side with the Raiders against the Confederacy.
(Engines) Attempt to flee while the two groups are distracted.
(Engines) Attempt to flee while the two groups are distracted.
(Engines) Attempt to flee while the two groups are distracted.
(Engines) Attempt to flee while the two groups are distracted.
(Cloaking) Attempt to escape the battle under cloak.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CLASH_CONFED_RAIDERS_SIDE_CONFED
event.text: You move alongside the Confederate formation and engage the Raiders. The Confederate ships provide supporting fire.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CLASH_CONFED_RAIDERS_SIDE_RAIDERS
event.text: You move alongside the Raiders and engage the Confederate ships. The Raiders provide supporting fire.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CLASH_CONFED_RAIDERS_FLEE_FAILURE
event.text: You attempt to flee, but a Raider ship spots your maneuver and breaks away to attack you.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CLASH_SOK_RAIDERS
event.text: A Sons of Korhal detachment and a group of Raiders are fighting over a disabled transport near this beacon. Neither group is willing to surrender the cargo, and both begin broadcasting requests for your assistance.

choice.text: Side with the Sons of Korhal against the Raiders.
Side with the Raiders against the Sons of Korhal.
(Engines) Attempt to flee while the two groups are distracted.
(Engines) Attempt to flee while the two groups are distracted.
(Engines) Attempt to flee while the two groups are distracted.
(Engines) Attempt to flee while the two groups are distracted.
(Cloaking) Attempt to escape the battle under cloak.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CLASH_SOK_RAIDERS_SIDE_SOK
event.text: You move alongside the Sons of Korhal and engage the Raiders. The Sons of Korhal provide supporting fire.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CLASH_SOK_RAIDERS_SIDE_RAIDERS
event.text: You move alongside the Raiders and engage the Sons of Korhal. The Raiders provide supporting fire.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CLASH_SOK_RAIDERS_FLEE_FAILURE
event.text: You attempt to flee, but a Sons of Korhal ship breaks away from the fighting and blocks your escape.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_CLASH_FLEE_SUCCESS
event.text: You slip past the fighting ships and leave the battle before either faction can pursue you.

destroyed.text: The Confederate ship is destroyed. You salvage what remains.

deadCrew.text: With the Confederate crew defeated, you collect what supplies remain.

destroyed.text: The Sons of Korhal ship is destroyed. You salvage what remains.

deadCrew.text: With the Sons of Korhal crew defeated, you collect what supplies remain.

destroyed.text: The Raider ship is destroyed. You salvage what remains.

deadCrew.text: With the Raider crew defeated, you collect what supplies remain.

event.name: STOREEVENT_TERRAN_ENGINEERING
event.text: A Terran Engineering Bay operates at this beacon. Repair drones and maintenance craft move between the station and nearby vessels while its quartermaster broadcasts an open offer of engineering supplies.
You are cleared for docking and directed toward the station's equipment exchange.
You power your weapons and move against the Engineering Bay. Warning lights flare across the station as its defensive systems come online.

event.name: STOREEVENT_TERRAN_BARRACKS
event.text: A heavily fortified Terran Barracks occupies this beacon. Troop transports continuously arrive and depart while recruiters and supply officers advertise personnel available for reassignment.
The station grants you access to its personnel and supply offices.
You open fire on the Barracks. Its garrison scrambles to defend the station.
Your hostile approach immediately triggers the Barracks' defenses. Its garrison scrambles to battle stations.

event.name: STOREEVENT_TERRAN_STARPORT
event.text: A large Terran Starport dominates the beacon. Military craft pass through its docking lanes while fuel, ammunition, and weapons are transferred between supply ships and station warehouses.
Traffic control assigns you a berth near the Starport's military supply exchange.
You break from the traffic pattern and open fire. Docking clamps retract and the Starport redirects power to its combat systems.

event.name: STOREEVENT_TERRAN_FACTORY
event.text: A Terran Factory fills the surrounding space with cargo traffic. Finished components and equipment are being loaded onto transports directly from its production lines.
A factory representative gives you access to the facility's commercial inventory.
As you move to attack, production lines shut down and armored bulkheads seal across the Factory. Its defensive systems activate.

event.name: STOREEVENT_TERRAN_COMMAND
event.text: A Terran Command Center coordinates military activity throughout the surrounding region. Despite the constant communications traffic, its logistics division permits passing vessels to purchase repairs and military supplies.

choice.text: Request access to the Command Center's supplies.

event.text: Command authorizes limited access to its repair docks and logistical reserves.
Your weapons lock onto the Command Center. The station immediately declares you hostile and redirects its military systems against your ship.

event.name: STOREEVENT_TERRAN_SCIENCE
event.text: A Terran Science Facility is positioned at this beacon, surrounded by sensor arrays and experimental equipment. Its research administration offers selected technology to approved vessels.
You receive clearance to inspect technology released by the facility's research division.
You open fire on the Science Facility. Its research personnel scramble to defend the station.
Research personnel scramble for cover as you begin your attack. Experimental systems power up throughout the facility as it prepares to defend itself.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FLEET_CHECK
event.text: The pursuing fleet has caught up to you. A Terran identification sweep cuts through the sector as hostile ships move to intercept.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FLEET_CHECK_NEBULA
event.text: The pursuing fleet has caught up to you inside the nebula. Distorted Terran sensor pings echo through the clouds.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_FLEET_BATTLECRUISER
event.text: [STARCRAFT] Your Terran ship signature confuses the automated fleet routing long enough to draw a Terran response instead of the standard Rebel fleet ship. A battlecruiser breaks formation and moves to engage.
